title: Mumbai Protests Over Detentions and CEC Resignation Demand
seoTitle: Mumbai protest against CEC and detentions

tea.why: Protesters and political allies demonstrated against the detention of demonstrators and alleged irregularities in the electoral process.
tea.want: Demonstrators are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the release of detained protesters.
tea.changed: Oct 11: Political leaders joined demonstrations in Mumbai following police detentions of protesters and party workers.

summary: Political parties including Shiv Sena (UBT) and the Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) joined demonstrations in Mumbai in solidarity with a campaign demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral irregularities. Demonstrations and subsequent tensions occurred near Shivaji Park and outside Shiv Sena Bhavan in Dadar after police detained protesters and political workers due to a lack of official permission for the gathering. Leaders confronted authorities, demanded the immediate release of detained individuals, and warned of a state bandh if party workers were manhandled. According to sources, authorities registered an FIR regarding an earlier march held without clearance.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Release of detained protesters and workers
response: According to the sources, Mumbai Police did not grant permission for the gathering and detained several protesters and political workers. Authorities also registered an FIR against the organisers of an earlier joint morcha for lacking mandatory clearance and violating prohibitory orders.

updates.text: Political leaders joined demonstrations in Mumbai following the detention of protesters and party workers.
